notes.title: Release Dates for Ace Patrol: Pacific Skies Announced!
notes.notes:
Sid Meier's Ace Patrol: Pacific Skies will be available on November 5th on Steam and on November 7th on the App Store.

Take flight and join the conversation on Ace Patrol's Facebook page!

https://www.facebook.com/acepatrolgame
